rongmei.title: Kau Eden namthan dai gaimei khou

lines: 1. Kauh Eden namthan dai gaimei khou
Kanloumei guai ta ariu puni;
Lung rianramei guai maan ngam puni,
Tingsaengzaeng gaipui ram tang pukhou.
He Eden… namthan dai…
Kahunung… khangsuang gai!
Khou tei tingsaeng na zaengthaek puni
Pou rui damthanloumei ram khou tei.
2. Tingkao namthan dai nthanpui ram,
Kandi hei aniu tat tuan pukhou
Nthanmei nun guangtang reimei le
Ariu puni poubaomei hukhou.
3. Khou tei thanmei nun kariu puni
Muzung le martur guloumei guai;
Alao nun guloumei guai tei le
Namthan daimei khoutei lusuan ni.
4. Tingkao thang tei ringmei dui luang e,
Kaipou rui ngan makna gaanhmei khou
Banchra nun le nzianmei nun ta
Hou khang tei ai nkhuanlian lak khe.
